rawContent: @CourtTV I used to enjoy legal “experts” on CourtTV when they were more abt substantive analysis. Now it’s 90% Depp fan club BS. Sad. I started out very sympathetic to Depp, but tho Heard is quite flawed, too much of his ugliness has come out for him play the hero against #MeToo excess.

@robotchicken670 @neezimusmaximus @RiriRites @mldauber Cultist? That's rich! I see her flaws. And I leaned Depp thru abt 75% of trial.But alway w a foot on the ground & open mind.(The lure was there) AH was awkward, but there were🚩🚩🚩JD didnt resolve for me. Like therapy info & MORE. Sorry, he's not The One to play #MeToo Wronged.

@gregcook09 @GopherMelinda @jamesfromcourt You don't show you comprehend my posts or trial bc you mischaracterize/severely minimize what I say, what was said at trial that's key. So this is not going anywhere. If you want a hero to stand up against #MeToo excess, that's great, but Johnny just didn't make the cut.

@overworkedmum3 @snowphieee @custodypeace @Eve_Barlow Of course not. A sober adult calling out the witch hunters is not the place to prove him right by acting shamefully. But you know it's happening all over, day after day. This is not a #MeToo excess correction. Johnny aint the guy for THAT role & this nightmare is no correction.

@CourtTV If DeppFan law & psych "experts" on this show (save a few true professionals) have achieved their goal, Johnny wins. Society loses. Terrible decision for women, abused women AND men, everywhere. I had thought Depp might stand for #MeToo excess, but he's not right for the role.

@EnuffNosey @CourtTV When trial began I leaned Depp, thought he might be the one to stand up to #MeToo excess (a valuable, necessary movement, but "off" in some cases) Always kept open mind, but red flags never resolved put the LIE to Depp's "I never hit AH". He's NOT the one to play this role

America is an ever more scary place. I've opposed excess in #MeToo, but this insane witch(Amber)hunt & trashing of all MeToo is just another excess - & really ugly. I never agreed w "believe all women", but #Depp will never be our course correction hero. The UK trial got it right

@CourtTV @jackrice said #MeToo did harm, nothing abt good it did. Is he that backward or a sloppy communicator? He seemed to walk it back a bit after seeing celebrity tweet supporting AH. Probably sloppy... But he gushed PROJohnny throughout trial. Maybe goes where the wind blows. Many do

@George_Roumelis @Twitter 1/U know me not. Until this trial I had Depp stuck in the 90s w Gilbert Grape, Dead Man & Kate Moss. DISinterested. #MeToo not my big cause, but def did some good & had some excesses. "Believe all women" is stupid... as stupid as believing the Depp fantasy, his global swindle.

@George_Roumelis @Twitter 1/Fair question. To understand my thinking, I don't see it as black v white. So saying she lied/embellished sometimes doesn't make her The Liar, him The Truthteller. I think she exaggerated & lied sometimes. He did TOO. At first I thought he might rep the wrongly #MeToo -ed...

@Hughwilk187 @littlelili123 @LisaLis70232483 @NotOllieHolt You're entirely missing the plot bc you are the ones  "screaming", seemingly to release long simmering anger at #MeToo excess, due to someone perhaps wronged by it - yourself or others? Johnny seems to be playing your avenging hero. But THIS is NOT that. Wrong movie. & just wrong
